claims.scope: uniform Walsh Boolean source; arbitrary nonempty shift U; arbitrary distinguished shift-pair block D; arbitrary oriented remainder H; arbitrary full-support probability reference Q
claims.statement: The exact Boolean multiplication equation implies P(H)P(tau H)>=Delta_D^2. If P(tau H)<=Gamma and ell=Delta_D^2/Gamma>=Q(H), then D_2(P||Q)>=d_2(ell||Q(H))=sup_t[t ell-log_2(1-Q(H)+Q(H)2^t)].

claims.scope: g_m=1-2 1_{x=0}, p=2^{1-m}, and balanced suspension F_m(y,x)=y g_m(x)
claims.statement: For the full-complement oriented high-cardinality transversal H_m, the signed cancellation certificate forces P(H_m)=p(1-p), and K_occ(F_m)>=d_2(p(1-p)||Q_m(H_m))=(1/2)m^2 p+O(mp), while the exact K_occ(F_m)=m^2 p+O(mp). Hence this one bounded variational event captures one half of the leading rare-event KL asymptotic.
